summary: A Jumeirah location, a named doctor and WhatsApp booking are strengths, but blank images, repeated cards and unclear booking buttons appear to cost you bookings.

findings.problem: Several images have empty sources, including Body treatments, Clinica Errami and Google Reviews, and the Price List link has no target.
findings.cost: Blank images and a dead price link hide proof and prices that patients look for.
findings.fix: Real images and a working price list.

findings.problem: The Body, Skin, Wellness and Face cards and the Popular Treatments block each appear twice, and several headings such as Latest Technology have no text under them.
findings.cost: Repeated and empty sections make the page feel unfinished.
findings.fix: One clean structure with finished sections.

findings.problem: A blog heading says Clinica Erami, Speak to a Expert is misspelled, and the page claims 1500+ Satisfied Customers while Instagram says 1000+ Happy Clients.
findings.cost: Typos and conflicting numbers weaken trust.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one verified set of figures.

findings.problem: The Book Your Appointment buttons lead to no visible form, only four undated reviews show, only one doctor has a profile, and WhatsApp links show tracking tags.
findings.cost: Patients ready to book face extra steps and thin proof.
findings.fix: A booking form, a full review wall and complete doctor profiles.

redesign: Real images, a working price list and a clean page structure.
A booking form with WhatsApp that sends a clean message.
A full review wall and complete doctor profiles.
